name: whisperlag
description: WhisperLag - A mobile-first, anonymous-by-design Quality Assurance System for the University of Lagos.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @whisperlag/api" "npm run dev -w @whisperlag/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @whisperlag/shared && npm run build -w @whisperlag/api && npm run build -w @whisperlag/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @whisperlag/shared && npm run typecheck -w @whisperlag/api && npm run typecheck -w @whisperlag/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @whisperlag/shared && npm run test -w @whisperlag/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @whisperlag/api && npm run lint -w @whisperlag/web
